name: Sleep instead of spinning
description: KH3 (APP_VER 01.00, VERSION 01.10): the render thread sleeps while it waits for GPU query results, and the game thread sleeps through the frame-rate cap instead of yielding in a loop. Same frames, less CPU.
title: CUSA15072

module_signatures.evidence: eboot+0x3a0d10: entry of the GnmRHI query wait loop (prologue, two sceKernelGetProcessTimeCounter calls, cmp byte [r15],0).
eboot+0x3a0eb8: the query loop's timeout check (process time counter to seconds, compare, ja to the timeout exit) and its back edge at eboot+0x3a0eee.
eboot+0x3955d0: GnmRHI RHIGetRenderQueryResult (the only caller of the query wait loop, twice).
eboot+0x5d8dfc0: entry of UEngine::UpdateTimeAndHandleMaxTickRate (UnrealEngine.cpp lines 1534/1634 in its log calls).
eboot+0x5d8e2ea: the tick-rate wait loop: call scePthreadYield; call sceKernelGetProcessTimeCounter; convert, times the seconds-per-cycle global; compare with [rbp-0x40]; jb back to the yield.

bindings.name: kh3_sceKernelUsleep
bindings.evidence: eboot+0x77499e0: PLT entry of the eboot's sceKernelUsleep import (jmp [rip+disp] through its GOT slot).

bindings.name: kh3_scePthreadYield
bindings.evidence: eboot+0x774ab70: PLT entry of the eboot's scePthreadYield import, the call the tick-rate loop makes.

bindings.name: kh3_sceKernelGetProcessTimeCounter
bindings.evidence: eboot+0x7749820: PLT entry of the eboot's sceKernelGetProcessTimeCounter import, the clock the tick-rate loop compares.

bindings.name: kh3_seconds_per_cycle
bindings.evidence: eboot+0xa7065f8: double the tick-rate code multiplies the process time counter by (vmulsd ... cs:qword_A7065F8 after the u64-to-double conversion) to get seconds, as for [rbp-0x40].

sites.name: query_wait_back_edge
sites.evidence: eboot+0x3a0eee in the query wait loop eboot+0x3a0d10: cmp byte [r15],0; jz eboot+0x3a0d70 (loop head). r15 is the caller's result flag, written at eboot+0x3a0ea3 (or 0x3a0fa0) in this round. Reached only by falling through the timeout check at eboot+0x3a0ee8; neither instruction is a branch target.

sites.name: tick_wait_round
sites.evidence: eboot+0x5d8e2ea in UEngine::UpdateTimeAndHandleMaxTickRate: call scePthreadYield (5 bytes), the body of the wait loop that ends at eboot+0x5d8e31a (jb back here while the process time is below the end time at rbp-0x40). Branches into it (jz at eboot+0x5d8e1f4, jb at eboot+0x5d8e31a) land on its first byte. The yield's result is unused; rax is overwritten by the next call.
